coordinator.note: pre-registration §4 starts the examples at 2021. The 2021 examples are built by engines whose volume k is the hand-set constant (no volume fit can end before 2021), and they are in EVERY graded season's fit (rows_from_k_excluded_seasons), not only 2022's. The served recipe starts at 2022 (fantasy-coordinator.js); sensitivity.coordinator_served_recipe reports it, post hoc, for 2023 and 2024. Standing rule 3 on the training replay is for the Independent Auditor to rule on.
